metadata.frame: base-local: origin = center of base_link; +X = forward (to bed), +Y = left, +Z = up; units mm
metadata.source_geometry: model_key_facts.json + STAGE2G_SOURCE_DATA.md (all confirmed values measured from Blender)
metadata.note: Parameters marked confirmed = measured from Blender. Parameters marked parametric = design freedom, no value invented. NO mass assigned to solid block.

envelope_confirmed.status: confirmed (Blender gabarit limit, NOT an approved frame design)

lift_interface_confirmed.status: axis/travel confirmed; real node dimensions parametric (assumption A6)

wheels_confirmed.status: confirmed (wheel bodies fit inside 670mm envelope with ~1.6mm margin)

mounting_zone.note: brackets/pivot bearings above wheel top (-27.75); drive units if motorized castors

radius_mm.constraint: must contain 2 screws + 2 guides + motor + brake + sync shaft of unknown sizes

lift_column_zone.pass_through: moving column of lift passes vertically; opening diameter parameter

candidate_placement: rear half (X<0) between lift zone and rear frame
under floor level if ground clearance increased (not allowed by current envelope)
battery_zone.mass: parametric m_battery (NOT part of 213.134 kg recipe — composition of base unknown, audit 2V.1 U2)

cable_trays.type: channels along frame and from base to lift column
cable_trays.routing: wheel wells -> frame corners -> central column -> up

service_access.type: removable top cover panels + side hatches
openings: top: access to lift drive, battery; sides: electronics, connectors

explicit_prohibitions: no solid aluminium block assignment (213.134 kg is recipe on gabarit block, NOT a part — audit 2V.1)
no invented purchased-component dimensions (battery/controller/drive sizes stay parametric)
no mass computed for empty component envelopes
no final material or wall thickness without calculation

bed_approach_constraints.rule: base front face must reach bed_edge - c; front of base = +335.14mm from center; no protrusions beyond envelope allowed
